name: ui/skeleton
title: Skeleton
summary: The registry skeleton: a loading placeholder on the muted token with the 17px card-scale corner, sized by class.
behaviour: Pulses on the `--muted` token; prefers-reduced-motion is the stylesheet's job.
Takes the radius-xl corner (17px), the card scale.

aria: Not aria-hidden: a consumer that shows a skeleton announces loading itself, or hides the skeleton.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is markup with no script.

contract:
contract
  slot is "skeleton"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/skeleton"
  class contains "animate-pulse"
  class contains "bg-muted"
end
